scope: 25 source groups, 23 papers/articles plus 2 official implementation groups; targeted sections and actual code where specified

source_groups.title: Attention Is All You Need
source_groups.finding: Learned compatibility and value transport compose across depth; changing a metric alone does not reproduce the whole layer.
source_groups.limitations: Transformer matrix products; no direct runtime adoption.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Hopfield Networks Is All You Need
source_groups.finding: Attention admits an associative energy interpretation for the stated continuous update.
source_groups.limitations: No inherited convergence guarantee for a different hard finite-group transition.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Attention Approximates Sparse Distributed Memory
parts_read: 2-3 Hamming neighborhood overlap to exponential attention
source_groups.finding: Strongest direct primary bridge between Hamming neighborhoods and attention.
source_groups.limitations: Approximation and random-pattern assumptions do not certify this finite codebook.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Similarity Estimation Techniques from Rounding Algorithms
parts_read: 3 random hyperplane hash family and angular disagreement
source_groups.finding: Random sign disagreements estimate angular distance.
source_groups.limitations: Does not establish deterministic H4 sign-bank equivalence or semantics.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: SE(3)-Transformers: 3D Roto-Translation Equivariant Attention Networks
source_groups.finding: Preserve orientation-bearing values separately from invariant attention scores.
source_groups.limitations: Uses tensor contractions and is evaluated on geometric data.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Geometric Algebra Transformer
source_groups.finding: Typed geometric objects/operators can share a symmetry-respecting network.
source_groups.limitations: Dense and attention contractions remain; geometric-data results are not prose results.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: nGPT: Normalized Transformer with Representation Learning on the Hypersphere
source_groups.finding: Normalized state displacements connect geometry with optimization.
source_groups.limitations: Official source uses Linear layers FlashAttention and dense MLP.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: HELM: Hyperbolic Large Language Models via Mixture-of-Curvature Experts
source_groups.finding: Geometry requires explicit compatible maps normalization and value aggregation.
source_groups.limitations: HLT contains W transpose x; MoE not authorized by current project.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
source_groups.finding: Content-dependent retention and write/read dynamics address a weakness of static recurrence.
source_groups.limitations: Dense projections and state contractions remain.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Eagle and Finch: RWKV with Matrix-Valued States and Dynamic Recurrence
source_groups.finding: State capacity and content-dependent recurrence matter in a real recurrent language model.
source_groups.limitations: Matrix-valued memory and matrix-vector projections violate the strict serving rule.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Retentive Network: A Successor to Transformer for Large Language Models
source_groups.finding: Training and serving can share a recurrence while using different execution schedules.
source_groups.limitations: Outer products and query-state contraction remain even when spelled sum/multiply.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Gated Linear Attention Transformers with Hardware-Efficient Training
source_groups.finding: Data-dependent forgetting improves compressed associative memory.
source_groups.limitations: Matrix-state linear attention is not mathematical-matmul-free.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
source_groups.finding: Targeted association correction and broad forgetting solve different problems.
source_groups.limitations: Uses matrix-state online regression; implementation not adopted.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Scalable MatMul-free Language Modeling
parts_read: FPGA ternary matrix multiplication functional unit
source_groups.finding: Avoiding multiplier instructions does not eliminate mathematical matrix products.
source_groups.limitations: Signed accumulation remains a dense linear contraction.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Reformer: The Efficient Transformer
source_groups.finding: Use hashing to reduce candidate comparisons instead of materializing all pairs.
source_groups.limitations: Still a transformer with selected-bucket dot-product attention.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks
source_groups.finding: Train continuous gate choices and discretize to Boolean inference.
source_groups.limitations: Evidence primarily classification; relaxation mismatch remains relevant.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Convolutional Differentiable Logic Gate Networks
source_groups.finding: Structured connectivity and pass-through initialization improve earlier logic-network limitations.
source_groups.limitations: Not a proof of scalable recurrent prose learning or cheap laptop training.
source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Neural Discrete Representation Learning
source_groups.finding: Quantized forward with approximate backward can learn useful discrete representations.

source_groups.read_scope: targeted sections; not full proof replication

source_groups.title: Categorical Reparameterization with Gumbel-Softmax
source_groups.finding: Hard categorical forward with surrogate backward is a plausible training tool.

source_groups.title: VL-JEPA: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Vision-language
source_groups.finding: Latent target prediction is useful while exact text generation remains separate.

source_groups.title: data2vec: A General Framework for Self-supervised Learning in Speech, Vision and Language
parts_read: official EMA teacher and target layer aggregation
